g.text: charge the call: produce introduction and the COMM
unapply; take the request and the ack
take room: encoded length + 64 for each item
produce the reply on the ack:
reply introduction and its COMM are charged
keep the record on the trigger,
deploy log: the record on the introduction
and on the COMM copy; native evidence
Replay: proposer self-certification and every validator
E1: a record sits only on the trigger of a matched slot,
its copies are equal, and no copy is failed
replay produce on the gpt4 channel
E2: a returned produce with a record must fire
a linear call of a recorded process
reject: recorded output on an unrecorded call
reply = the record; the service is never called
produce the reply on the ack: the same charges as play
exact compare of the produce update with the record
check_complete: every record is used once
equal phlo, receipts and post-state root
Effects outside the checkpoint (gRPC messages, Chroma writes,
audio files, printed lines) are never undone. A deploy can be
played more than once, so the bound is one call per play.
